exchange.title: Import and export
exchange.uncertain: Result unconfirmed. Retry this submission; do not import again.
exchange.changes: Replaces the name, description, tags, parameters and steps. Previous versions are kept. Steps: {{before}} → {{after}}.
exchange.conflict: Workflow changed. Reload and confirm again.
exchange.requiresTarget: Importing does not run the workflow. Select a desktop and authorize before running.
exchange.requiresOCR: Importing does not run the workflow. Running requires a desktop, authorization and OCR.
exchange.disclosure: Exports are not redacted. Review text, parameter defaults and images before sharing.
exchange.exportIntro: Choose a format, then a save location.
exchange.importIntro: Review contents and choose a destination.
exchange.jsonUnavailable: Contains images. Use ZIP or a directory.

zip.title: ZIP bundle
zip.description: Configuration and images for sharing or backup

directory.title: Directory
directory.description: Separate configuration and images for editing
directory.preview: Keep the relative paths between configuration and images.

json.title: Standalone JSON
json.preview: One configuration file to import or edit.

actionMenu.debugHint: Run the saved version step by step
actionMenu.historyHint: Restore or export a previous version

resizePanelHint: Drag to resize, use arrow keys to adjust, or double-click to reset

ocr.fixedParameters: Parameters are saved with this script version. Later global changes do not affect them. Text is optional only for Read text.
ocr.targetHint: Contains and regex locate the entire text span. Positions follow spatial order. Recognized text does not guarantee a clickable control.
ocr.settingsFailed: OCR defaults could not be read. Retry before adding text configuration.
ocr.drawScopeHint: Draw a region and choose Apply region before testing OCR.
ocr.staleScope: Desktop dimensions changed. Select a new region or use the full screen.
ocr.previewCounts: {{recognized}} recognized across the screen. Only matches are shown, with their original IDs.
ocr.emptyMatches: No text matches the current region and conditions
ocr.useText: Fill recognized text and keep the match mode
ocr.selectionBound: Text is bound to a parameter. Selection only highlights its location.
ocr.incomplete: OCR results were truncated. Absence and uniqueness cannot be established.
ocr.reportTruncated: Stored details reached their limit. Statistics still describe the complete observation.
ocr.redacted: This query uses a sensitive parameter. Only statistics are retained; text and screenshots are omitted.

analysis.title: Screen structure
analysis.loading: Loading models and analyzing the screen. First use may take longer…
analysis.truncated: Result limit reached. Some results are omitted.
analysis.counts: Detected regions {{regions}} · Recognized text {{texts}} · OCR spans {{spans}}
analysis.boundary: Coordinates use original screenshot pixels; right and bottom edges are exclusive. A center point does not guarantee clickability.

saveForHistory: Save the workflow to view versions

previewTools.title: View and selection controls
previewTools.wheel: Scroll to zoom · Ctrl + drag to pan
previewTools.hint: Drag to draw or move the selection, or resize it at the edges. Ctrl + left drag always pans the image. 0 to fit, 1 for actual size. View changes do not modify the configuration.

selection.drawHint: Drag to select · Drag inside to move · Resize at edges
selection.templateSourceMissing: This template has no source selection. Select it again to save its position.
selection.move: Move selection (left drag, arrow keys to nudge, Shift for larger steps)
selection.redoHint: Redo (Ctrl / ⌘ + Shift + Z, or Ctrl + Y)
selection.deleteHint: Delete selection (Delete), keeping the applied configuration

boundValuesNotStored: Actual parameter values are not stored. Only parameter names are shown.
actionDetailsUnavailable: Action configuration for this version is unavailable. Recorded execution details are shown below.
pausedHint: Resume the workflow or inspect the next action with a single step.
cancelledHint: No further steps will be executed.

definitionStatus.loading: Loading action configuration for this execution…
definitionStatus.ready: Step details use the fixed version v{{version}} from this execution.
definitionStatus.unavailable: The execution version is unavailable. Step results and run controls remain available.
definitionStatus.failed: Could not load action configuration. Step results and run controls remain available.

window.detached: Desktop automation is open in a separate window
window.description: Continue editing and reviewing runs in the separate window. Drafts and tasks stay in sync.
window.failed: Window handoff did not finish. Retry or bring it back from the main window.
window.syncFailed: Window state could not be synced. Refresh and try again.
window.operationFailed: The action was not confirmed. Refresh the state to check the result. Unconfirmed actions are not sent again automatically.

chainHint: Steps run in order. Drag to reorder within the same branch.
templateHint: Select a template in the preview or import an image.
externalUpdateHint: Your draft is preserved. Unsaved changes are confirmed before loading.

exchange.replace: Explicit overwrite with a target check before publishing
exchange.host: Files are on the Termous Core host
exchange.readHint: Read only the selected ZIP, or JSON and its declared, referenced images in the adjacent assets directory. A frozen preview does not save or run a workflow.
exchange.writeHint: Write to the selected location. Literal text and template images are retained. Directories must be new; replacing a file requires explicit authorization.

approval.hostRunHint: Approval runs this version on the local desktop without confirming each step; the run is cancelled when its caller ends. Keyboard input affects the currently focused application. Selecting a display does not isolate applications. You can reclaim control at any time.
approval.runHint: Approval applies to this version without confirming each step. The run can access existing shared resources and is cancelled when its caller ends.

noWorkflows: Create your first flow to get started
overviewDescription: Build reusable desktop flows, locate targets in screenshots, and follow each execution from start to finish.

guide.composeHint: Combine mouse, keyboard, waits, and conditions.
guide.locateHint: Connect a desktop and use points or image matching.
guide.reviewHint: Save, execute, and inspect results with screenshot evidence.

runSelectionHint: Select an execution to inspect its progress, step results, and screenshot evidence.
noStepResults: Step results will appear here when execution begins.
deleteHint: Existing reports and their version snapshots are retained.
unsavedDescription: Leaving discards your edits. Running flows continue.
addFirstStep: Start with an action or image condition
parameterHint: Bind parameters in step properties. Sensitive text is entered at launch and is never persisted.
previewHint: Choose a connected desktop to capture points and templates
cropFailed: Cannot crop image. Refresh the screenshot.
frameChanged: The frame changed. Candidate coordinates refer to the latest sample; refresh the preview.
runConsent: This flow will control the selected desktop
runLimits: Control lasts up to 30 minutes and expires after 15 idle minutes. VNC takeover may switch viewers. The flow can access resources already shared with the target.
keepConnection: Keep the new connection after completion
reuseConnection: Reuse an existing session for the exact Profile; create only when none exists.
temporaryConnectionHint: Connections are kept by default. Turning this off only closes a connection created by this run that is still exclusive and on the same generation. Existing connections are always retained.
targetUnavailable: The selected target is unavailable or its session generation has changed. Select the target again.
uncertainHint: Some input may have been sent. Inspect the target; no automatic retry will occur.
cleanupFailed: Safe release of control could not be confirmed
requestUnconfirmed: The request result is unconfirmed. Retry reuses the same operation. Check run history before starting again.
validationPassed: Structure validated. Parameters and target capabilities are checked at launch.

errors.workflow_exchange_source_changed: The source file changed while being read. Try again.
errors.workflow_exchange_unsafe_path: The asset path contains a link or leaves the configuration directory.
errors.workflow_exchange_unsafe_file: The source is not a supported regular file or exceeds the size limit.
errors.workflow_exchange_target_exists: The destination exists or changed during export. Choose a new name.
errors.workflow_exchange_response_invalid: The file transfer response was incomplete or failed validation. Try again.
errors.workflow_exchange_short_write: The file could not be fully written. Check free disk space.
errors.workflow_exchange_sender_denied: This window cannot access workflow files. Reopen it and try again.
errors.workflow_exchange_request_failed: The workflow file request failed. Check the Core service.
errors.desktop_workflow_exchange_media_type: This exchange request content type is unsupported.
errors.desktop_workflow_exchange_invalid: The workflow file or its assets do not match the exchange format.
errors.desktop_workflow_exchange_limit: The workflow exceeds file size, asset count or expanded size limits.
errors.desktop_workflow_exchange_expired: The preview expired. Select the file again.
errors.desktop_workflow_exchange_busy: Workflow exchange is busy. Try again shortly.
errors.desktop_workflow_exchange_committed: This import was already committed. Retrieve its existing result.
errors.desktop_workflow_exchange_timeout: Workflow file processing timed out. Check the file and retry.
errors.desktop_workflow_exchange_storage_failed: Workflow staging or saving failed. Check disk space and permissions.
errors.workflow_exchange_save_first: Save the current draft before exporting.
errors.workflow_exchange_io_failed: File access failed. Check the path, permissions and free disk space.
errors.workflow_exchange_location_unavailable: Save location unavailable. Open the folder manually.
errors.workflow_exchange_directory_missing: The folder was moved or deleted. Check the save location.
errors.workflow_exchange_directory_open_failed: Could not open the folder. Check your file manager and try again.
errors.workflow_exchange_file_missing: The configuration or a referenced image is missing.
errors.workflow_exchange_assets_require_directo: The workflow includes images. Choose ZIP or a configuration directory.
errors.desktop_workflow_ocr_invalid: Invalid text query. Check the expression, region and OCR size.
errors.desktop_workflow_ocr_missing: The text condition was not met before the deadline.
errors.desktop_workflow_ocr_ambiguous: Multiple text targets matched. Narrow the region or specify a spatial position.
errors.desktop_workflow_ocr_incomplete: Truncated OCR cannot establish absence or locate a target reliably.
errors.desktop_workflow_ocr_invalid_response: OCR returned an invalid result. This observation was stopped.
errors.desktop_workflow_ocr_runtime_changed: The OCR service restarted. Start a new run.
errors.desktop_workflow_ocr_target_stale: The target kept changing. No mouse action was dispatched.
errors.analysis_busy: Screen analysis is busy. Try again shortly.
errors.analysis_unavailable: Screen analysis is unavailable. Try again later.
errors.analysis_version_mismatch: Screen analysis versions are incompatible. Update the app.
errors.analysis_result_limit: Analysis results exceed the processing limit.
errors.analysis_not_found: Analysis record unavailable. Analyze the screen again.
errors.analysis_out_of_memory: Not enough memory. Close some apps and try again.
errors.analysis_timeout: Screen analysis timed out. Try again.
errors.analysis_invalid_request: Invalid analysis parameters. Review them and try again.
errors.analysis_conflict: This operation is unavailable in the current analysis state.
errors.analysis_storage_failed: Could not save the analysis record. Try again.
errors.analysis_storage_limit: Analysis storage limit reached. Clear some history.
errors.analysis_runtime_changed: The analysis service restarted. Analyze the screen again.
errors.analysis_failed: Screen analysis did not complete. Try again.
errors.analysis_interrupted: Screen analysis was interrupted. Analyze the screen again.
errors.analysis_not_ready: Analysis is not complete. Try again shortly.
errors.analysis_crop_failed: Could not create the template image. Try again.
errors.analysis_settings_unavailable: Could not open screen analysis settings. Try again.
errors.desktop_workflow_request_conflict: Request ID already used with different parameters
errors.desktop_workflow_not_found: Flow, run or preview not found
errors.desktop_workflow_busy: Target busy or concurrency limit reached
errors.desktop_workflow_image_invalid: Invalid template. Choose an opaque image with distinct features.
errors.desktop_workflow_image_missing: Image not found within the time limit
errors.desktop_workflow_image_ambiguous: Multiple matches. Narrow the region or use a more distinctive template.
errors.desktop_display_stale: Display size or executor changed. Recheck the target.
errors.desktop_control_locked: Another controller owns the desktop. Explicit takeover is required.
errors.desktop_capability_unsupported: Operation is not supported by the target
errors.desktop_not_ready: Desktop is not ready. Complete the connection prompts and retry.
errors.desktop_prepare_timeout: Desktop operation timed out. Check the connection.
errors.desktop_busy: Desktop is busy. Try again later.
errors.desktop_invalid_request: Invalid desktop operation. Check the step settings.
errors.desktop_conflict: Another entry is still using this connection
errors.desktop_idempotency_conflict: Request ID already used with different parameters
errors.desktop_invalid_response: Invalid capture or matching response. Refresh and retry.
errors.desktop_workflow_storage_failed: Cannot persist run state. Input dispatch stopped.
errors.desktop_workflow_match_limit: Matching budget exceeded. Narrow the region or use fewer scales.
errors.desktop_workflow_match_timeout: Matching timed out. Narrow the search region.
errors.desktop_workflow_interrupted: Run interrupted; it will not be replayed.

diagnostics.exchange_format_legacy: This is an older development exchange format. Export the workflow again using the current version.
diagnostics.sensitive_default_forbidden: Sensitive parameters must be text without a saved default
diagnostics.parameter_default_invalid: Default value has the wrong type or is out of range
diagnostics.depth_limit: Steps can be nested at most 8 levels
diagnostics.binding_invalid: Parameter is missing, has the wrong type, or is invalid for this field
diagnostics.unexpected_children: Only branches and loops support child steps
diagnostics.step_budget_invalid: Timeout, delay, or iteration count is out of range
diagnostics.action_limit: Action content or duration exceeds the limit
diagnostics.image_target_invalid: Check the template, scales, threshold, and search region
diagnostics.target_kind_invalid: Choose an image target or a fixed point
diagnostics.point_invalid: Check the coordinates and reference desktop size
diagnostics.image_required: Select or import an image template
